items.docs: Returns the user row, role row, and resolved permission list for the authenticated caller, derived from the auth context's own `auth_lookup_by_cognito_id`. Unlike `GET /users/{id}` and `GET /roles`, this endpoint is keyed to the JWT (not to the currently viewed organization), so it works for super-admins whose user/role rows live in the cluster-internal org but who are viewing a different tenant.
